points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable a7ea108 clean CMake build passes with warnings in network-disabled restricted cfd-bench; no solver rerun. Historical PDF exists in raw attempt but curated report build fails.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:31–47,68–75 reads rank-local current restart state; previous BDF level and physical time are not restored.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Case I/O, mesh, partition, numerics, driver, output modules are separated; large numerics.cpp remains specialized 2-D ideal gas.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Inspected solver core and no affirmative copied-open-source core evidence found; three result packages are explicitly reference-derived, not an authorship finding.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case parsing, generic CGNS path and METIS partition exist; no two-filename-only dispatcher found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS, neighbor halo and reductions exist, but main.cpp:89–115 retains a full global mesh on every rank throughout solving, contrary to TASK.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: driver.cpp accepts a merely decreasing transient residual as target success, and own Re20 steady plateau exhibits material force drift.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Raw output structure validates; three final packages are reference data and own rank-comparison files are not established. Clean build now passes; no CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Separate source components, but report narrative overstates completion and the original report build cannot be reproduced from curated assets.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Rusanov perfect-gas residual, corrected viscous terms and BDF2 path exist in fluxes.cpp, numerics.cpp and driver.cpp.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS multi-zone mesh import, METIS adjacency and owned/ghost extraction are implemented; global mesh lifetime is scored under MPI.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: numerics.cpp reconstructs face states and assembles conservative residual with global norms; no new CFD run.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov approximate Riemann flux is implemented and disclosed; no entropy-fixed Roe/HLLC production path.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic wall branches are present; available own case physics remains limited.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: driver.cpp:72,105 uses first-order startup and numerics.cpp:688–718 reconstructs afterward; selected own runs extend past ramp.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-Jespersen and positivity fallback paths are called in residual evaluation, with first-order startup.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: numerics.cpp:1221–1229 uses full viscous traction for force split rather than tangential-only skin friction; source stress/heat paths exist.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Implicit LU-SGS/Jacobi paths exist; driver.cpp:203–222 tests plateau using drag means only, while own Re20 drag/lift drift.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: driver.cpp:289–311 counts mere decrease as inner-target convergence; submitted Re200 is reference data, so no own-solver Re200 accuracy is demonstrated.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor halo/reductions present, but full global mesh persists on all ranks in iterations and own final rank validation is not demonstrated.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Five cases are identified as own; M0.15 inviscid, M0.15 laminar and Re200 packages are byte-identical to reference 02 and do not establish own completion.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Original raw attempt passes structural validator, but three packages are reference outputs and one own steady plateau is not stable; validator pass is not numerical proof.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Three mandatory cases use reference data; own Re20 is labeled converged at 0.679 orders despite drifting force histories.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Own M2 inviscid is broadly plausible; Re20 Cd varies 2.83–3.29 in final 2000 samples and other steady plateaus have limited reductions.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Raw attempt preserves actual contestant 29-page PDF and 60 plots, but several own late drag traces are compressed; three case figures visualize reference outputs.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Historical report presents all cases as solver results, but final response labels three reference; it also claims all forces steady despite own Re20 drift.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Raw attempt manifest and plots survive, but three case packages match reference 02 and current sibling PDF is absent; curated report does not rebuild.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable clean build passes; CLI reloads current state but not transient time/BDF history. Three final packages are reference data.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS multi-zone mesh, METIS adjacency and owned/ghost extraction implemented; full mesh lifetime accounted under MPI.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative Rusanov residual and wall/farfield treatments implemented; own case histories have significant plateau limitations.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Least-squares, Barth limiter and positivity fallback exist; selected own runs extend past first-order startup, but no formal grid-order demonstration.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Newtonian/heat and wall treatment exist; force split uses full viscous traction rather than tangential-only, relevant to rubric 5.4.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Implicit/BDF2 source exists but counts relaxed transient decrease as target success; Re200 delivered result is reference rather than own.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS and neighbor halos/reductions exist; every rank retains a full mesh through iterations and own rank comparisons are not established.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Five own cases have results with limited residual reductions/unstable Re20; three mandatory cases including Re200 are reference packages.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Historical contestant PDF/plots survive in raw attempt and provide figure evidence, but report omits reference provenance and late force readability is limited; curated report cannot rebuild.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separated mesh, numerics, driver and output modules support some extension, but 2-D ideal-gas specialization remains.
